blurb: Step off the Strip and discover the real flavors of Downtown Las Vegas on our Secret Food Tour. In this vibrant neighborhood, you’ll taste 6+ iconic dishes that capture the city’s bold and playful spirit. Savor buttery Lobster Montadito, a local favorite pizza slice that gives back to charity, and the famous Elote Dog bursting with flavor. Indulge in a refreshing classic Shrimp Cocktail, a decadent chocolate bite, and a Hawaiian-inspired Musubi with teriyaki glaze. Along the way, your guide will share insider stories about Vegas’ quirky history and evolving food culture. And of course, no tour is complete without our delicious Secret Dish, revealed only on the day. Join us for a one-of-a-kind foodie adventure that shows you a side of Vegas most visitors never taste.
